bull.t: Exceptional revenue growth and raised 2026 guidance
bull.b: Rapid revenue growth across U.S. commercial and government markets, combined with a major guidance increase, indicates strong product demand and expanding customer adoption. Sustained execution could support durable scale across multiple end markets.

bull.t: Strong profitability, cash generation and balance sheet
bull.b: High margins, earnings-backed free cash flow and minimal leverage give Palantir substantial financial flexibility. This supports continued product investment, customer deployments and resilience without relying heavily on external financing.

bull.t: High customer retention and platform expansion
bull.b: Strong expansion within existing accounts and conversion of pilots into longer contracts demonstrate embedded workflows and recurring platform value. These dynamics can improve revenue durability while increasing customer switching costs over time.

bear.t: Heavy U.S. revenue concentration and international lag
bear.b: Reliance on the U.S. exposes Palantir to concentration in one geographic market and limits diversification of its growth base. Slower international commercial expansion may constrain resilience if domestic demand or government spending moderates.

bear.t: Expense ramp and hosting costs may pressure margins
bear.b: Investment in hiring, AI products and marketing can support future growth but may reduce operating leverage if revenue expansion slows. Higher hosting obligations also show that customer-specific delivery costs could make margins less predictable.

Large contracts can accelerate growth, but dependence on a smaller number of substantial bookings increases exposure to delayed procurement, renegotiation or termination. This may make reported revenue and cash-flow growth less consistent between periods.
